def solve(env, goal):
    import re

    m = re.search(r"cool some (\w+) and put it in (\w+)", goal)
    obj_type = m.group(1)
    rec_type = m.group(2)

    env.step("look")

    items = [(n, num) for n, num in re.findall(r"a (\w+) (\d+)", env.observation)]

    fridge_id = next(i for i in items if i[0] == "fridge")
    target_id = next(i for i in items if i[0] == rec_type)

    obj_items = [i for i in items if i[0] == obj_type]

    obj_num = None
    if obj_items:
        obj_num = obj_items[0][1]
        env.step(f"take {obj_type} {obj_num}")
    else:
        for name, num in items:
            if name in ("fridge", rec_type):
                continue
            env.step(f"go to {name} {num}")
            obs = env.observation
            obj_match = re.search(rf"{obj_type}\s+(\d+)", obs)
            if obj_match:
                obj_num = obj_match.group(1)
                env.step(f"take {obj_type} {obj_num}")
                break

    f_num = fridge_id[1]
    env.step(f"go to fridge {f_num}")

    t_num = target_id[1]
    env.step(f"go to {rec_type} {t_num}")
    env.step(f"move {obj_type} {obj_num} to {rec_type} {t_num}")

def solve(env, goal):
    import re

    m = re.search(r"cool some (\w+) and put it in (\w+)", goal)
    obj_type = m.group(1)
    rec_type = m.group(2)

    env.step("look")
    items = [(n, num) for n, num in re.findall(r"a (\w+) (\d+)", env.observation)]

    fridge_id = next(i for i in items if i[0] == "fridge")
    target_id = next(i for i in items if i[0] == rec_type)

    surface_types = {"countertop", "diningtable", "sinkbasin", "stoveburner", "microwave", "toaster", "coffeemachine"}
    other_types = [i for i in items if i[0] not in surface_types - {"fridge", rec_type}]

    obj_num = None
    obj_container = None

    # Check surfaces first
    for name, num in items:
        if name not in surface_types:
            continue
        env.step(f"go to {name} {num}")
        obs = env.observation
        obj_match = re.search(rf"\b{obj_type}\s+(\d+)\b", obs)
        if obj_match:
            obj_num = obj_match.group(1)
            obj_container = f"{name} {num}"
            break

    # If not found, check other containers
    if obj_num is None:
        for name, num in other_types:
            if name in ("fridge", rec_type):
                continue
            env.step(f"go to {name} {num}")
            obs = env.observation
            if "is closed" in obs:
                env.step(f"open {name} {num}")
                obs = env.observation
            obj_match = re.search(rf"\b{obj_type}\s+(\d+)\b", obs)
            if obj_match:
                obj_num = obj_match.group(1)
                obj_container = f"{name} {num}"
                break

    if obj_num is None:
        return

    env.step(f"take {obj_type} {obj_num} from {obj_container}")

    f_num = fridge_id[1]
    env.step(f"go to fridge {f_num}")
    env.step(f"open fridge {f_num}")
    env.step(f"cool {obj_type} {obj_num} with fridge {f_num}")
    env.step(f"close fridge {f_num}")

    t_num = target_id[1]
    env.step(f"go to {rec_type} {t_num}")
    env.step(f"move {obj_type} {obj_num} to {rec_type} {t_num}")
